description: Creates an official WhatsApp click-to-chat (wa.me) link. Use when the user wants to send a WhatsApp message or customer reply. Formats the message and normalizes international phone numbers into E.164 digits. Opens WhatsApp on mobile or WhatsApp Web on desktop with the draft pre-filled for user confirmation. Nothing is stored and no messages are sent by our server.

phone.description: Optional recipient phone number in international format with country code (for example, +14155552671). Non-digit characters are automatically stripped.

text.description: Message text (at most 4,096 characters). Formatted as plain text with line breaks.

name: create_whatsapp_link

character_count.description: Length of the message text in characters.

phone.description: Normalized recipient phone digits or null.

url_length.description: Total length of the generated wa.me URL.

warning.description: Warning if URL exceeds safe limits.

title: Create WhatsApp link
